assumptions.compounding: Future value uses APY as an annual compounded rate anchored to Account Open Date 2026-10-22: balance = deposit * (1 + APY)^years.
assumptions.constant_rate: Scenario 'constant' holds today's verified ongoing APY unchanged after Year 1. Savings APYs are variable and can change at any time.
assumptions.fallback_rate: Scenario 'fallback' applies Year-1 effective yield for Year 1, then min(account ongoing APY, FDIC national savings average 0.38%) for Years 2–10.
assumptions.fdic_limit: Coverage is $250,000 single owner, $500,000 2-owner joint, and up to $1,250,000 revocable/irrevocable trust (5+ beneficiaries) per depositor per FDIC bank charter (CERT).
assumptions.fees: Projections report gross interest and net-of-fee interest separately; cash opening bonuses are tracked separately and never mixed silently into ongoing APY.
assumptions.mobile_filter: Multi-bank FDIC ladders include only accounts with confirmed mobile banking apps (excluding web-only Alto by BMO) and deduplicate strictly by FDIC Certificate (CERT).
